n: Old Ghan Heritage Railway and Museum
w: Named for the old Ghan line that once hauled passengers into the Red Centre, this narrow-gauge railway and museum keeps the rolling stock long after the tourist trains stopped running. The Road Transport Historical Society, next door at the truck hall of fame, keeps the yard alive.
s: The old Ghan line's rolling stock, permanently parked.
_facts: Australian railway museum in Alice Springs, Northern Territory
Attached to a narrow-gauge tourist railway line that is now closed
Operated by the Road Transport Historical Society, which also owns the adjacent National Road Transport Hall of Fame

w: Alice Springs' shrine to the road trains and truckies who ran the outback highways, this hall of fame sits beside the old narrow-gauge railway yard - two museums, one society, telling the story of how goods and people actually reached the middle of nowhere.
s: Alice Springs' shrine to the trucks that ran the outback.
_facts: Australian transport museum in Alice Springs, previously known as the National Road Transport Hall of Fame
Owned by the Road Transport Historical Society
Sits on the site adjoining the Old Ghan Heritage Railway and Museum, which the same society also operates

w: Sixteen hectares of arid-zone botany at the edge of the Red Centre, home to plants that actually belong in central Australia rather than anything imported from wetter, greener climates - a garden built to showcase the desert on its own terms.
s: Sixteen hectares of arid-zone botany in the Red Centre.
_facts: A 16-hectare botanic garden in Alice Springs, Northern Territory
Specialises in plants native to the arid central Australian region
